direct_geometry.stair_zone: In the frame-plan sketch, the stair/opening rectangle is bounded by O-P-Z-V; Z is the lower-right corner.
direct_geometry.A_prime_position: A' lies 1.20 m to the right of Z on the V-Z-A'-B'-C' line.
direct_geometry.crossing_line: A' also lies on a transverse frame/alignment line continuing downward in the frame-plan sketch.
direct_geometry.frame_elevation: The Telaio 5 elevation does not draw a vertical member at A' (23/32/41), although vertical members are drawn at Z and B'.

interpretation.meaning: A' is a real geometric intersection/control point used by the structural layout and calculation model, but it is not a column/support of the Telaio 5 elevation.

load_discontinuity_hypothesis.statement: The Z-A' 1.20 m subsegment is likely separated because A' marks the transition from the stair/opening-adjacent strip to the next floor field / transverse frame influence.

important_consequence.statement: C6 and C7 must not be treated as two independent physical column bays. They are calculation subsegments within the Z-B' beam line, split at A'.
